repos.name: OpenMC Studio
repos.notes: Runs from source inside WSL. SEED downloads and updates the code; it does not create the conda environment or the nuclear data.

prerequisites.label: Git
prerequisites.fix: Install Git for Windows from git-scm.com.

prerequisites.label: WSL with a Linux distribution
prerequisites.fix: Install WSL: open a terminal as administrator and run `wsl --install`.

prerequisites.label: The openmc-mcnp conda environment in WSL
args: source ~/miniconda3/etc/profile.d/conda.sh 2>/dev/null; conda env list | grep -q openmc-mcnp
prerequisites.fix: Create the environment as described in the OpenMC Studio README (setup folder).
